title: Propagate the Epic-20-canceled banner to dashboard-redesign-set pages 01-07 (currently read as ready-to-build)
rule: Tier-4 triage AREA NOTE — presents-as-current classification; egregious contradiction with reality

evidence.quote: Epic 20 (DNI-210) was canceled 2026-04-15 (all 12 child stories) ... the dashboard UI redesign specified in this set is **not shipped**.
**DNI-211** — 20.1: Schema Definition — trackId on 7 Config Tables + paceResetDate *(Canceled)*

why: Files 01 through 07 read as fully-approved, implementation-ready specs (dp-level layout tables, real Riverpod provider names, Dart variant-selection snippets, acceptance checklists all ticked [x]) with zero mention that Epic 20/DNI-210's 12 stories are Canceled — that fact lives only in the sibling 00-scenario-overview.md. An engineer or agent opening 01-dashboard.md, 06-progress-screen.md, or 07-track-detail.md directly (search, or a 'build the dashboard redesign' request) has no signal to check 00 first and could sink real implementation effort into a design the project has already dropped in favor of the Greenfield Rebuild (Epics 24-27, all still Backlog).
recommendation: Copy the same one-line cancellation banner from 00-scenario-overview.md:3 to the top of 01-dashboard.md, 02-card-program.md, 03-card-deadline.md, 04-card-velocity.md, 05-card-momentum.md, 06-progress-screen.md, and 07-track-detail.md — matching the pattern already applied consistently across all 19 files in docs/scenarios/evolution/.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 7 page-spec files under docs/scenarios/dashboard-redesign-set/dashboard-redesign/ (01 through 07) opens with a banner stating Epic 20/DNI-210 was canceled and the design is unshipped, matching 00-scenario-overview.md:3.
grep -L 'canceled' docs/scenarios/dashboard-redesign-set/dashboard-redesign/*.md returns none of 01-07 once fixed.
